comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Welcome to the DB, Darth. Is it possible you hit the "Send" button instead of "Edit/Update" when you were trying to edit the quest text? That would've made a blank comment, and not saved the quest data you were trying to enter. I made that mistake plenty when I got started. Thanks for showing an interest in helping to update the information on this site; hopefully you'll try again, as we can always use more help around here. Cheers, and great voyaging to you.
